hero.name: Thaís Moreira
hero.tagline: Bridging Legal Precision with Backend Architecture
description: Former lawyer with a postgraduate degree in Civil Law transitioning into backend development.
Currently specializing in building high-quality RESTful APIs with Django and Flask, applying clean architecture and professional engineering standards.

journey.title: Legal Background
journey.description: Bachelor's and Postgraduate degree in Civil Law from PUC Minas. Trained in rigorous problem analysis, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

journey.title: Career Pivot
journey.description: Decided to transition into tech, combining analytical skills from law with passion for programming and problem-solving through code.

journey.title: Focused Learning
journey.description: Completed 20+ technical certifications and currently advancing through Alura's comprehensive Backend Python Career Track with hands-on projects.

learning.title: Alura - Backend Python Career Track
learning.description: Comprehensive backend development path covering APIs with Django and Flask, clean architecture, CI/CD, and real-world market challenges.

projects.title: NLW Operator - Computer Vision
projects.description: Advanced computer vision monorepo featuring a LeNet-5 CNN implementation for MNIST, a custom gesture recognition lab with MediaPipe and YOLO, and a real-time web application built with FastHTML and WebSockets for low-latency video processing.

projects.title: School Manager API - DRF
projects.description: Educational management system built with Django REST Framework. Features complex data relationships, API versioning, custom filtering, pagination, and robust input validation.

projects.title: Alura Space - Django Architecture & Refactor
projects.description: Comprehensive gallery application featuring a high-impact personal initiative refactor. Eliminated 70% of code duplication using DRY principles, implemented a hierarchical template inheritance system, and established professional standards through Conventional Commits.

projects.title: SecureBank API - JWT Authentication
projects.description: Banking authentication API implementing JWT tokens and Argon2 password hashing. Features user authentication, secure password storage, and automated testing with Pytest.

projects.title: Clean Code Flask API
projects.description: RESTful API built with Flask following clean architecture principles, featuring user management with SQLAlchemy ORM and comprehensive test coverage.

projects.title: DevStage - Event Registration System
projects.description: Event registration API with referral tracking system. Users generate referral links and earn points when others register using their links.
